newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Ten injured in Serbia-Bosnia border blast, Tanjug.
newsitem.headline: Ten injured in Serbia-Bosnia border blast, Tanjug.

text.p: Ten people were injured when a bomb exploded in front of a bar in the Serbian town of Loznica close to the border with Bosnia, the official Yugoslav news agency Tanjug reported on Saturday.

It quoted a local doctor as saying the injured were all males aged between 17 and 28, but it did not say whether the incident, which occurred on Friday, was politically-inspired or merely a criminal act.
